The research highlights the legal mechanisms of ransoming Muslim captives and offers insights into the dynamics of piracy and its implications for commerce and daily life in this significant Ottoman port city.

discoveries.title: Hittite Religion and the West
discoveries.context_excerpt: This paper explores the intricate connections between Hittite religion and Western Anatolian cultures, particularly focusing on the kingdom of Arzawa and its ritual practices. It emphasizes the use of Hittite texts to derive insights into Arzawa's religious rituals, including the roles of the Protective Deity of the kursa and local deities. The discussion extends to the influence of these rituals on later Greek religious practices, highlighting the cultural exchanges in the region during the Hittite period.

discoveries.context_excerpt: What role does oil play in international security? While the threat of “resource wars” over possession of oil reserves is often exaggerated, the sum total of the political effects generated by the oil industry makes it a leading cause of war. # Petros Lantzas

 Petros Lantzas, also known as Pietro Lanza or Pedro Lanza, was a Corfiot Greek born around 1533 on the island of Corfu. He became a rebel, spy, privateer and pirate who worked against Ottoman rule in the Balkans. He started his career with the Republic of Venice and from 1574 served the Spanish Empire. During the Ottoman–Venetian wars, Lantzas led raids on Ottoman ships, helped Epirus rebels, and played a role in several anti-Ottoman plots.
